dedupe_keys.name: drl ews coastal multi hazard emergency response simulator

description: The DRL-EWS research team publishes an open coastal emergency-warning simulator and learning workflow under MIT. A Zenodo version 1.0.0 archive points to its GitHub repository; the current repository README describes version 2.0.0, which adds a deterministic experiment harness, frozen scenarios, campaign runner and figure generators while retaining the original simulator in a legacy folder. This model can compare warning-policy choices under coastal multi-hazard scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the repository. Coverage is the documented study scenarios and configurable simulator, not a validated operational warning service for a particular coastal authority. A limitation is that policy quality depends on hazard and behavioural assumptions and on the reward design. The current repository and archived Zenodo release are not identical versions, so results must name the version used. The repository was inspected, but no source archive was downloaded, dependency installed or learning run reproduced.
